pairs.name: train_station_owner
pairs.note: Pass 2 (train_sotr.py): one camera serves both station views. The owner's frame is a later moment of the Trailer 1 @35.7 s shot, framed as T1 cropped 1.50x (T1 x 0.1525-0.819, y 0.353-1.0); our owner's view is the same crop of station_frame (STATION_CAM's position and pitch, a 35.3-degree lens shifted onto it). The film rectangles keep clear of the three player icons drawn over the frame and of people. The gold boxes lie on blade surface only (the film's right-hand fan, which the sun lights, and our right-hand blades).

regions.label: shed glazing, west, high
regions.note: The west wall of the shed above the beam: white fins and glazing.

regions.label: shed wall, west, low
regions.note: Between the departure board and the beam's inner column, above the train.

regions.label: east nose, body
regions.note: On the body below the roof line in both.

regions.label: gold blade, surface only
regions.note: Every pixel of both boxes is blade (checked with the work folder's tools/goldbox.py). Our sculpture is our own single radial fan; the film's (two fans on a pendant) is not copied.

pairs.name: train_station_wide
pairs.note: Pass 2: our wide view fitted to Trailer 1 @35.7 s. The film rectangles keep clear of the lettering on the beam, the posters and the guards.

regions.label: gold blade, surface only
regions.note: The second blade from the left at mid-length in both; every pixel is blade (tools/goldbox.py).

regions.label: shed wall, west, low
regions.note: The shed's west wall inside the portal, between its middle and inner columns, in both. Pass 2a's film box [0.29, 0.66, 0.34, 0.74] lay on the dark lattice outside the film's portal, which we do not model.

regions.label: shed wall, east, low
regions.note: The shed's east wall inside the portal, in both (pass 2a's film box was on the lattice outside it).

regions.label: west nose
regions.note: Right of the lamp, where the film's train shows its maroon panel and ours its band.

regions.label: east nose
regions.note: The east train's body below its roof line in both (pass 2a's film box took in the shed wall above it).

pairs.name: train_nose_detail
pairs.note: Pass 2: our nose car from the platform against the film's detail of both trains. The fin regions pair surfaces under the same light (fins in shade, fins in sun), not the same wall.

regions.label: nose, black lacquer
regions.note: The capsule beside the lamp on the side facing the camera, in both.

regions.label: shed fins in shade
regions.note: Ours: the far east wall high, which the low sun leaves in shade (the cooler of our two walls); the film's: its left wall high.

regions.label: shed fins in sun, high
regions.note: Ours: the near east wall, in the late sun (the warmer of our two); the film's: its right wall high.

regions.label: banner
regions.note: Both carry their gold motif; ours is our own (a rising half-sun and a chevron), the film's is not copied.

pairs.name: train_car1_saloon
pairs.note: The film side is a fan-edit frame (trust it less than the studio's trailers); it is the only clear frame of the cars' materials. The rectangles keep clear of the two people.

regions.label: brass window frame
regions.note: Lit brass face of the near window's frame in both (the film's polished sill, ours the frame's face under the cove); every pixel of ours is brass (work folder tools/boxfind.py).

regions.label: window at night
regions.note: The upper glass of a near window, clear of its frame, in both.

pairs.name: train_car2_dining
pairs.note: The film side is a fan-edit frame (trust it less). The rectangles keep clear of the two people.

regions.label: hammered vault
regions.note: The upper vault overhead, away from the lamps, in both (every pixel of ours is vault).

regions.label: hammered vault, lamp-lit
regions.note: The vault where the lamps and coves light it, in both.
